title: Choose the admin dashboard structure
question: Which first-view composition should guide Motkarta's internal data desk?

options.label: Concourse Table
options.lineage: Stockholm transit information boards and civic data desks
options.thesis: A dense, calm venue table owns the screen; urgent rows announce themselves without breaking the grid.
options.viewport: A narrow navigation rail, action summary, advanced filters, and the sortable venue table fill the first viewport.
options.risk: The density needs careful column priority on smaller screens.

options.label: Evidence Workbench
options.lineage: Editorial verification desks and source comparison workspaces
options.thesis: The queue and the selected venue share the screen so provenance and conflicts stay beside the decision.
options.viewport: A compact filter rail and venue list occupy the left two-thirds while a persistent evidence inspector occupies the right.
options.risk: The inspector reduces comparison width and needs a strong collapsed state.

options.label: Operations Index
options.lineage: Scandinavian civic-service indexes and newsroom planning sheets
options.thesis: Quality, freshness, and queue pressure lead; the venue table begins immediately below the operating picture.
options.viewport: A top navigation, broad quality band, prioritized work queues, and the first venue rows form one vertical operating index.
options.risk: Summary content can delay the core venue work if allowed to grow.
